body:
**Original comment by Robin Mills (Bitbucket: [Robin Mills](https://bitbucket.org/Robin Mills), ).**

----------------------------------------

Please don’t open a ticket about the auto\_ptr messages.  I’ve documented the builds switches `cmake .. -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=11 -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-Wno-deprecated` in [README.md](http://README.md) concerning this matter.  
  
As you have a work around \(demoting <winsock2.h> to http.cpp\), you’re not stuck.  I can’t change that in the codebase because I made the change for a solid reason: [https://github.com/Exiv2/exiv2/pull/1222](https://github.com/Exiv2/exiv2/pull/1222)  to deal with C\+\+11 which wasn’t supported by 0.27.2.  
  
Here are three thoughts:  
  
1  I  add a flag EXIV2\_BUILDING\_LIBRARY and set it when the library is being built \(but not when you’re using the library\) and only include winsock when that is set.  So you won’t “pull in” <winsock2.h>  
  
2 You have an empty <winsock2.h> in your system header path that obscures the Microsoft version.  
  
3 This is a collision between your code and the Microsoft <winsock2.h> and has nothing to do with Exiv2.  However the collision has surfaced since I “promoted” winsock2.h into <exiv2/exiv2.hpp>
